parts.name: bar-chart
parts.title: Bar Chart
parts.description: A customizable bar chart component with animations, hover effects, responsive design, and support for both vertical and horizontal orientations with filled or outline variants

parts.name: funnel-chart
parts.title: Funnel Chart
parts.description: A five-variant funnel with faithful stage values, conversion and drop-off metrics, growing geometry, and keyboard and touch inspection

parts.name: gauge-chart
parts.title: Gauge Chart
parts.description: A 270-degree arc gauge with truthful range limits, nonoverlapping color zones, animated value updates, and keyboard and touch inspection

parts.name: heatmap
parts.title: Heatmap Chart
parts.description: A grid, radial and stock heatmap with explicit missing values, faithful color scales, weighted areas, and keyboard and touch inspection

parts.name: line-chart
parts.title: Line Chart
parts.description: A line chart with multiple series, faithful gap handling, four curve interpolations, accessible inspection, gradient areas, and geometry-matched loading states

parts.name: pie-chart
parts.title: Pie Chart
parts.description: A customizable pie and donut chart component with animated segments, interactive hover effects, center labels, and responsive design

parts.name: radar-chart
parts.title: Radar Chart
parts.description: A multi-axis radar chart with explicit axis ranges, polygons that grow from the center, keyboard and touch inspection, and responsive labels

parts.name: sankey-chart
parts.title: Sankey Chart
parts.description: A Sankey chart for branching and converging flows with proportional ribbons, reachable-path highlighting, keyboard and touch inspection, and a left-to-right reveal

parts.name: scatter-plot
parts.title: Scatter Plot
parts.description: A scatter and bubble chart with area-scaled bubbles, clipped viewports and trends, keyboard and touch inspection, and points that grow at fixed coordinates

parts.name: stacked-bar-chart
parts.title: Stacked Bar Chart
parts.description: A stacked bar chart with faithful signed stacks, growth from zero, segment inspection by keyboard and touch, and vertical or horizontal layouts

parts.name: treemap-chart
parts.title: Treemap Chart
parts.description: A treemap with three proportional layouts, nested or flat views, group navigation, contrast-aware labels, growing tiles, and keyboard and touch inspection

parts.name: waterfall-chart
parts.title: Waterfall Chart
parts.description: A waterfall chart with absolute balances, computed sums and period subtotals, vertical and horizontal layouts, filled or outline bars, growth animations, and keyboard and touch inspection
